production.note: PROGMEM song asset only; engine cost is tracked separately.

instrumented.note: Instrumented preview fixture (core + ATMlib + score + speaker enable). Not a production or whole-game measurement.

limitations: The WAV is the emulated mono speaker mix (DDRC6/7 differential); per-channel isolation is not possible from a single capture. Channel ordering is evidenced by the original-engine tick trace and the time-isolated preview fixture (tests/music_authoring/fixtures/basic/isolated.json).

While Timer4 PWM runs, emulated neutral is 0 plus a small DC quantization offset (measured steady silence = 2 counts). After the score ends the engine stops PWM and the captured level is a constant DC rail (~-2000, zero AC), not 0; both are acoustically silent but not equal to neutral 0.
Sound is only produced when the Arduboy speaker pins are outputs (DDRC6/7) and Timer4 PWM is active; a fixture that does not enable them captures silence.

capabilities.note: This render command owns bounded WAV preview. The frontend capabilities payload stays pinned by its 3ii.1 golden fixtures.
